subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` now, and should hook-loaded extras remain available on the no-override subagent/cron path or become `full`-only?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the answer changes a public config/default surface and which workspace context existing sessions receive after upgrade.

options.title: Accept after compatibility fix
options.body: Proceed with this PR shape after preserving current no-override hook-extra behavior and documenting the new explicit-tier semantics.

options.title: Make hook extras full-only
options.body: Accept the upgrade behavior intentionally, with docs and release-note guidance telling users to set `bootstrapTier: "full"` for existing hook-extra context.

options.title: Fold into broader bootstrap selection
options.body: Pause this PR and settle tiering alongside related session-scoped extra-file and deterministic context-selection proposals.
